blurb: The Dork Den hosts gaming events and tournaments such as Age of Sigmar escalation leagues, Pokémon League Cups, Lorcana Set Championships, Magic: The Gathering Store Championships, and casual board game nights. Players participate in competitive and casual gaming sessions with entry fees and prizes. Events occur on scheduled dates and include booster packs and prizes for winners.
